Title: MeSH therapeutic use based on chemical structure
Description: Assigns a molecule to twelve broad therapeutic categories drawn from MeSH, inferring likely clinical use straight from structure. Meyer and colleagues trained convolutional neural networks and random forests on drugs annotated with their MeSH therapeutic classes, showing that chemical structure alone carries substantial signal about function. Ersilia provides a replicated version built from the published approach. Categories are broad and not mutually exclusive, so several may score highly for one compound.
Interpretation: Probability that the compound belongs to each of twelve MeSH therapeutic categories.
